3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 26-year-old male received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 20 September 2026. Approximately 13 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Urticaria. The patient sought medical attention and was treated in the emergency department. The outcome was recovered with sequelae. The reporter does not consider the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
